Sara — great to connect. Short answers up front and a next step: we can get a one-page commercial sketch + technical options over the next business day. I attached a working draft (redwood-proposal-draft.pdf) with three configuration profiles. High-level notes:

- Latency-first: keep model at fp16/float32, minimal batching (max tokens per batch = 64), aggressive pinning on dedicated capacity. Expect higher token cost but P95 ~ 80-120ms depending on QPS.
- Cost-first: int8/int4 quantized runtime, 50-100ms batching windows, prefix KV caching (TTL 30m), expect ~45-60% token-cost reduction, P95 increases ~40-60ms depending on cold-starts.
- Balanced: int8 quant + selective KV caching for hot prefixes, adaptive batching by route. Middle-ground: ~25-35% cost reduction, P95 in line with your 120ms SLO under expected QPS.

Guarantees: we can commit to a P95 SLO when KV cache hit >= 75% on Dedicated or Hosted with reserved capacity — we need to validate exact traffic characteristics during a short pilot (2 weeks).

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync with your procurement + SRE + our commercial lead. Priyom, can you paste a compact pricing sketch (commits -> discount bands) and a couple bullet tradeoffs?

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions
Redwood Inference

Quick pricing sketch (high level) — numbers are illustrative and can be firmed up after the pilot: 

Assumptions: average input+output = 220 tokens; baseline hosted token rate = $0.00018/token (fp16). Caching assumptions: hot-prefix hit rate 75% -> effective token reduction on served cost. Quantization: int8 ~ 1.7x throughput improvement vs fp16; int4 experimental ~2.5x but with minor quality delta for >1024-context models.

Commit tiers (monthly committed spend) -> effective discount on list token cost when paired with recommended runtime profile:
- Tier A: $25k / mo -> 5% discount (recommended: balanced configuration, KV cache TTL 30m)
- Tier B: $75k / mo -> 12% discount + 30% of cost-savings credited as implementation credit for engineering support (for quant rollout)
- Tier C: $200k / mo -> 22% discount + 60k in onboarding credits + 2-week performance tuning (includes custom kernel selection)

Optional add-ons: Private deployment (VPC, KMS) +12% platform fee; SLA hardening (4 x P95 checks / month + runbook) -> $8k / mo.

Expected token-cost reductions by profile (approx):
- Latency-first: 0-5%
- Balanced: 20-35%
- Cost-first (int8 + cache heavy): 40-60%

Operational asks we will need for a firm SLO:
- A 2-week pilot with representative traffic (we'll run a synthetic overlay to ensure reproducibility).
- Sample P95, QPS-by-route, and hit-rate projections.

I can convert this into a one-page table for procurement. Vivek — anything to add on sequencing or committed term tradeoffs?

— Priyom
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
